text: 风势增强，把火焰吹成一场烈焰风暴，沿山坡灌木席卷而下，烧进森林。树枝在你们周围噼啪作响，大火迅速蔓延，西尔维娅和诺曼被呛得咳嗽。你们半盲着眼冲过烟雾。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 403
text: The wind picks up, fanning the flames into an inferno, which sweeps down through the scrub of the hillside and into the forest. Sylvia and Norman cough as branches around you crackle and the conflagration spreads. You race through the smoke, half blind.
